items.title: Show HN: Open-source model routing for coding agents at Astra-level performance
items.excerpt: A few months ago we started building a model router for coding agents because we thought we could outperform any single model with an ensemble approach. Recently we’ve achieved that milestone and I want to talk about how we did it. First of all, a quick explanation: the Weave Router ( https://github.com/weave-os/router ) plugs into any coding agent (e.g. Claude Code or Codex) and intelligently switches between LLMs. So, for example, Astra handles tricky debugging or complex system design tasks, and Deepseek v4 Flash handles simple frontend updates. What we’re announcing today is our new routin
items.summary: Hacker News post describes Weave Router, open-source model routing for coding agents that intelligently switches between LLMs (e.g., Astra for debugging, Deepseek v4 Flash for frontend updates) to match task complexity.
items.usefulness: Could help Python tool builders optimize latency and cost by routing coding tasks to specialized models rather than using single LLM for all work.
items.to_verify: Whether Weave Router actually achieves claimed Astra-level performance across diverse coding tasks, and what switching overhead exists.

items.title: Identity Management for Agentic AI [pdf] (2025)
items.summary: Hacker News links to OpenID Foundation PDF (2025) titled 'Identity Management for Agentic AI', addressing governance and security for autonomous AI agents.
items.usefulness: Could clarify trust and access control mechanisms needed when building multi-agent Python systems that interact with external APIs or user data.
items.to_verify: What specific identity patterns the PDF recommends, whether recommendations apply to open-source agent frameworks, and any limitations noted.

economia|europa.title: Eurozone inflation hits three-year high of 3.8%
economia|europa.summary: Eurozone inflation reached 3.8% in September, a three-year high. Consumer prices rose more than expected, signaling persistent inflationary pressures.

economia|europa.summary: La Comisión Europea advierte que reestructurar la deuda del fondo europeo de recuperación aumentaría los costes de intereses. España había propuesto aplazar la amortización o reducir el capital inicial.

economia|europa.title: Isabel Schnabel: Central banks on-chain
economia|europa.summary: Isabel Schnabel discussed central banks' involvement in blockchain technology and on-chain financial systems. The remarks address digital currency developments.

economia|europa.title: Germany Explores Ways to Avoid Other UniCredit-Style Takeovers
economia|europa.summary: Germany is exploring legal changes to prevent foreign takeovers like UniCredit's acquisition of Commerzbank. The Italian bank built a large position using derivatives discreetly.

economia|europa.title: El Supremo impide que el secreto empresarial ampare malas prácticas
economia|europa.summary: El Tribunal Supremo anuló dos sentencias favorables a Iberdrola que condenaban a un directivo por revelar documentación confidencial. El secreto empresarial no puede amparar malas prácticas.

economia|asia.summary: Singapore is pursuing a larger role in the nuclear fusion energy industry. The initiative aligns with regional energy security and climate goals.

economia|asia.summary: Japan's largest power producer JERA established an oil storage company. The move supports energy supply stability and strategic reserves.

economia|america.summary: US mortgage rates surged the most in four years, pressuring the housing market. Homebuilders and buyers face challenging conditions as the midterm elections approach.

economia|america.summary: Federal Reserve Vice-Chair Philip Jefferson signaled the central bank will hold rates steady in October. His remarks echo dovish comments from other Fed officials.

economia|america.summary: Treasury bond traders are heavily betting on further Federal Reserve rate hikes despite anticipated job growth slowdown. Market expectations signal higher rates ahead.

politica|asia.summary: Taiwan celebrated the delayed delivery of two F-16V fighter jets as proof of continued US military support. The arrival follows the recent Xi-Trump summit.
